question: Who is the female singer of the song 'London Thumagda' from the film Queen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neha Kakkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **London Thumakda** is a popular Bollywood song from the movie **Queen**, released in 2014.
 
• The song is sung by **Neha Kakkar**, Labh Janjua, and Sonu Kakkar.
 
• It was composed by the music director duo **Amit Trivedi**, known for their distinctive style in Bollywood music.
 
• The lyrics of the song were penned by **Anvita Dutt**, who is celebrated for her quirky and engaging writing.
 
• The song gained widespread popularity for its upbeat rhythm and vibrant depiction of Indian wedding celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neha Kakkar** is a renowned Indian playback singer known for her energetic and melodious voice.
 
• She gained fame with songs like **Second Hand Jawani**, **Kala Chashma**, and **Aankh Marey**.
 
• Neha Kakkar started her singing journey by participating in the reality show **Indian Idol** and later became one of the judges on the same show.
 
• The movie **Queen**, starring **Kangana Ranaut**, is a critically acclaimed film that celebrates themes of self-discovery and empowerment.
 
• The song **London Thumakda** is widely recognized as one of the iconic tracks that adds to the joyous and celebratory vibe of Indian weddings.
